cues: At the zoo, a keeper offers a macaque a hand-held snack, and the animal peels it before eating.
During a tennis changeover, a player reaches into the courtside basket for quick carbohydrates.
At a contemporary art show, visitors queue to photograph a piece of fruit fixed to a wall with silver tape.
At checkout, a cashier keys in 4011 for the familiar yellow produce item sold individually.
At a Caribbean breakfast table, a cook serves pan-fried ripe slices beside eggs and salty cheese.
During recess, a child opens the familiar hand-held fruit with a single pull and shares its soft center with a friend.
